note: First training sweep (#452 rulings 3 and 4): the control three times on different seeds, then one knob at a time from the control (seed 0). Every overrides object replaces those keys of the features set's my_model.yaml; run 3's carries the control's mix, 32/32/64, so the controls' empty overrides are that mix only on run 3's features. Configs named control-* are the noise band. A batch mix is named positive/adversarial/ACAV, the order of batch_n_per_class read as positive, adversarial_negative, ACAV100M_sample: the control is 32/32/64 and upstream openWakeWord's is 50/50/1024.
